title: Compatibility and package audit of packages/fw-agent as it stands today
objective: packages/fw-agent has never been through this graph's release track (Team Configuration 4, new in PR #61). This directive runs it for real against the package as it currently stands on main -- not a hypothetical future release, an audit of what would actually be published if `npm publish` were run right now from packages/fw-agent.
base_sha_note: candidate_sha is 94388bd, the last commit that touched packages/fw-agent (confirmed identical to current HEAD's packages/fw-agent/{index.js,src/*,package.json} -- only test fixtures changed since, which npm pack doesn't include anyway). Chosen specifically to avoid .agent/'s own forbidden-path rule, which a HEAD-equivalent candidate_sha would trip for reasons unrelated to this directive's actual subject.
scope: packages/fw-agent's package.json, .npmignore (if present), README.md, LICENSE, and the real `npm pack --dry-run --json` output at candidate_sha 5974d06
out_of_scope: packages/fw-control -- not being prepared for a standalone npm release in this directive
actually running npm publish or any registry-modifying command -- audit only
success_criteria: compatibility-receipt.json reviews the eight dimensions against packages/fw-agent's current exports/engines/dependencies
release-audit-receipt.json's packaged_files is the real, verbatim npm pack --dry-run output, not asserted
